content:
After reporting that AirPods Pro 3 dropped to a historic low, the fall Prime Day deals quickly swept through Apple's latest Mac lineup. The entire Mac mini series, powered by the M6 chip, has reached new low prices, with reductions of nearly US$150, while the 2026 Mac Studio sees discounts approaching US$200.

In addition to the above offers, almost all M5 MacBook Air configurations are reduced by US$200, the M5 Pro MacBook Pro continues to enjoy a US$500 price reduction, Apple's brand-new minimalist full-character design Magic Keyboard is seeing its first discount, and the Magic Mouse is also on sale at a rare reduced price.

Readers planning to get a MacBook should note that the fall Prime Day has brought the Apple M5-powered MacBook Air series to its lowest price in recent months. Amazon is currently offering a solid US$200 discount on almost all configurations, with most models also available in multiple colours:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB US$1,099 (original price US$1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB US$1,399 (original price US$1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB US$1,599 (original price US$1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB US$1,299 (original price US$1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB US$1,599 (original price US$1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB US$1,799 (original price US$1,999)

Amazon brought several eye-catching markdowns to Apple's new Mac mini lineup this morning. From the entry-level M6 configuration to the top-of-the-line M5 Max model, the highest discount currently recorded is US$149, all at historic low prices:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB US$780 (original price US$899) — historic low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB US$950 (original price US$1,099) — historic low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB US$1,550 (original price US$1,699) — historic low

In addition to the above offers, the new Mac Studio equipped with 36GB RAM has also reached a historic low, with Amazon slashing US$199 off — the best deal since its launch last month:

  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max US$2,300 (original price US$2,499) — historic low

Although we are still waiting for (and hoping for) broader discounts on the MacBook Pro, Amazon has surprised us with a US$500 price reduction on the upgraded 2TB configuration — US$100 lower than its pre-increase price:

  • 14-inch MacBook Pro M5 Pro 24GB/2TB US$2,699 (original price US$3,199)

In addition, we have also tracked several selected deals on Apple Mac accessories. Specifically, both black and white Magic Mouse units are seeing a rare discount of nearly 25%, while the recently launched new Magic Keyboard, with its sleek full-character key design, is also enjoying its first discount:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (2026 new model) US$80 (original price US$99)
  • Apple Magic Mouse (white) US$60 (original price US$79)
  • Apple Magic Mouse (black) US$80 (original price US$99)
